en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a castle complex with two prominent square towers featuring ornate gabled tops and small lantern structures. The castle buildings with steep tiled roofs rise behind a tree-filled park and a decorative wall, with a wooden fence in the foreground. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as a castle in Strehla on the Elbe River.
